name: Gamma
description: Gamma is an AI tool for creating presentations, documents and simple websites.
strengths: A free plan with export to PDF, PPTX and Google Slides
limitations: Free is limited to 10 slides per prompt, and branding removal starts on Plus

free.details: No credit card required: 400 credits at signup, up to 10 slides per prompt, import from PDF and PPTX, export to PDF, PPTX, PNG and Google Slides.

plans.name: Free
highlights: Export to PDF, PPTX, PNG and Google Slides

plans.name: Plus
plans.billing: $12 per seat per month billed monthly; $9 per seat per month billed annually ($108)

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing: $25 per seat per month billed monthly; $18 per seat per month billed annually ($216)

plans.name: Ultra
plans.billing: $100 per seat per month billed monthly; $90 per seat per month billed annually ($1,080)
highlights: Most advanced AI models (text, image, video)

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD with a '$' sign; the page says prices are subject to tax depending on location. The Business tab was not read.

profile.headline: Presentations, documents and websites with an AI agent that knows your goal

capabilities.title: Start from a conversation
capabilities.text: The agent starts with a conversation, builds an outline first so you shape the story, and iterates in chat beside your deck.

capabilities.title: Get a look that fits the story
capabilities.text: Describe a style, attach inspiration, or let Gamma choose a look matched to your content, audience and brand.

capabilities.title: Edit any way you like
capabilities.text: Ask the agent for changes, drop in smart layouts, or move anything freely in freeform design mode.

capabilities.title: Bring your content in and send it out
capabilities.text: Import PowerPoint and PDF with formatting intact, pull content from Slack, Notion, Dropbox and more, and export to PowerPoint, PDF and other formats.

featureCards.name: Presentations
featureCards.text: Decks with clean export to PowerPoint, PDF and more.

featureCards.name: Documents
featureCards.text: One-pagers to white papers, structured and visual.

featureCards.name: Social media visuals
featureCards.text: Carousels and graphics sized for each platform, in your brand.

featureCards.name: Websites
featureCards.text: Prompt it, publish it and share the link.

featureCards.name: API
featureCards.text: Automate creation and editing inside your own product.

featureCards.name: Built-in AI images
featureCards.text: Infographics, illustrations and on-brand visuals, editable where you work.

featureCards.name: Custom instructions and brand controls
featureCards.text: Workspace templates and brand controls keep the output consistent.

audienceDetail.text: The site lists solopreneurs and startups among its users.
Gamma names top-tier universities, and educators appear among its customer quotes.
The site mentions customers such as IBM, Mastercard and Novartis helping shape the product.

scenarios.title: Build a pitch or sales deck
scenarios.text: Shape the outline in conversation, pick a style, and export to PowerPoint.

scenarios.title: Write a one-pager or white paper
scenarios.text: Produce a structured, on-brand document ready to share.

scenarios.title: Make social carousels
scenarios.text: Create graphics sized for each platform in your brand.

scenarios.title: Publish a quick website
scenarios.text: Turn a prompt into a live site and share the link.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Start for free button on gamma.app.
Tell the agent your goal and review the outline it proposes.
Describe a style or attach inspiration.
Edit by asking, dragging or dropping a layout, then export or share a link.
